programs.title: File-drop service:
programs.scope: **File-drop service:** upload files, list metadata, download by ID, enforce sizes, persist an index, and expire temporary entries.
programs.coverage: Binary HTTP, paths, JSON, dates, persistence
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Download arbitrary bytes unchanged; expired and unknown IDs return the documented statuses.

programs.title: Webhook inbox:
programs.scope: **Webhook inbox:** validate event envelopes, deduplicate event IDs, retain receipts, filter history, and export selected events.
programs.coverage: HTTP validation, sets, JSON arrays, logging
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Repeated delivery creates one stored event; malformed envelopes leave state unchanged.

programs.title: Bookmark redirector:
programs.scope: **Bookmark redirector:** create named links, validate destinations, issue redirects, count visits, and import/export bookmarks.
programs.coverage: Response headers, status codes, strings, atomic files
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Redirect Location is correct; restart preserves links and visit counts.

programs.title: Expiring paste service:
programs.scope: **Expiring paste service:** create text pastes with deadlines, distinguish public/private IDs, enforce size limits, and sweep expired entries.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: A Unicode paste survives restart and becomes inaccessible at its configured deadline.

programs.title: Versioned settings API:
programs.scope: **Versioned settings API:** update schema-listed fields, compare revision numbers, retain history, and roll back a selected revision.
programs.coverage: JSON types, enums, copy/value semantics, history
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Stale updates fail; rollback reconstructs the exact earlier settings.

programs.title: Scenario-based mock API:
programs.scope: **Scenario-based mock API:** load route definitions, match method/path, validate request fields, advance scenario states, and record a transcript.
programs.coverage: Routing, state machines, JSON, binary/text responses
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: A scripted request sequence yields exactly the configured statuses and state transitions.

programs.title: Leased work queue:
programs.scope: **Leased work queue:** enqueue JSON jobs, claim with a deadline, acknowledge, requeue expired leases, and inspect queue state.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: A crashed worker's job is reclaimable; an expired acknowledgement cannot remove a new lease.

programs.title: Resource reservation service:
programs.scope: **Resource reservation service:** create resources, book UTC intervals, reject overlaps, cancel bookings, and show an agenda.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Overlapping bookings fail; adjacent half-open intervals and cancellations behave consistently.

programs.title: Per-key rate-limit service:
programs.scope: **Per-key rate-limit service:** maintain sliding request windows, return allow/deny decisions, expose quota state, and restore it after restart.
programs.coverage: Float timestamps, list filtering, HTTP statuses
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Boundary-time requests obey the chosen window rule; different keys remain independent.

programs.title: Server-sent-event notification board:
programs.scope: **Server-sent-event notification board:** publish small events, stream subscriptions, retain replay IDs, and handle reconnects and slow readers.
programs.forecast: E: streaming responses, backpressure and disconnect handling
programs.acceptance: Reconnect resumes after the last acknowledged event; a slow subscriber does not block others.

programs.title: Service health monitor:
programs.scope: **Service health monitor:** poll configured endpoints, record latency and outages, apply failure thresholds, and write a status report.
programs.coverage: HTTP errors, clocks, logging, time series
programs.forecast: E: recoverable network errors
programs.acceptance: One unreachable endpoint is reported without stopping checks of the remaining endpoints.

programs.title: Paginated JSON harvester:
programs.scope: **Paginated JSON harvester:** follow a documented next-page URL, reject repeated cursors, deduplicate records, checkpoint, and resume a bounded import.
programs.coverage: HTTP client, sets, JSON, checkpoint files
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Restart resumes at the saved page; overlapping pages produce no duplicate record IDs.

programs.title: Resumable file downloader:
programs.scope: **Resumable file downloader:** fetch in ranges, save progress, detect changed validators, verify a digest, and atomically publish the final file.
programs.coverage: Binary client I/O, HTTP headers, hashing
programs.forecast: E: request/response headers, binary streaming, file handles and digest API
programs.acceptance: Interrupted download resumes correctly; a changed ETag prevents mixing file versions.

programs.title: HTTP contract test runner:
programs.scope: **HTTP contract test runner:** load fixture requests, check statuses and selected JSON fields, compare snapshots, and generate a failure report.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: A known faulty test server produces the expected named mismatches and summary counts.

programs.title: Webhook delivery outbox:
programs.scope: **Webhook delivery outbox:** persist deliveries, send idempotency keys, classify failures, back off, and move exhausted items to a dead-letter list.
programs.coverage: Retry state, headers, persistence, failure recovery
programs.forecast: E: custom client headers and recoverable I/O errors
programs.acceptance: A scripted sequence of disconnects and HTTP errors preserves pending deliveries across restart.

programs.title: Local website link auditor:
programs.scope: **Local website link auditor:** crawl a bounded local site, resolve relative links, deduplicate URLs, report broken links, and stop at a depth budget.
programs.coverage: URL resolution, HTML parsing, graph traversal
programs.forecast: E: HTML parser, URL resolution and recoverable client errors
programs.acceptance: Cycles terminate; relative links resolve correctly; external hosts are excluded by policy.

programs.title: JSON endpoint change watcher:
programs.scope: **JSON endpoint change watcher:** poll snapshots, compare nested fields, suppress configured paths, retain changes, and render a readable difference report.
programs.forecast: E: general object-key iteration and error recovery
programs.acceptance: Ignored fields produce no event; nested additions/removals are reported once per change.

programs.title: Quota-aware API batcher:
programs.scope: **Quota-aware API batcher:** read pending requests, honor rate-limit headers, checkpoint completed IDs, and resume without repeating successful work.
programs.forecast: E: client response headers and recoverable errors
programs.acceptance: A fixture server's retry deadlines are respected; already completed IDs are skipped after restart.

programs.title: Circuit-breaker gateway:
programs.scope: **Circuit-breaker gateway:** forward a fixed family of requests, count upstream failures, open the circuit, probe recovery, and expose state.
programs.forecast: E: recoverable client errors and forwarding headers/bodies
programs.acceptance: Closed/open/half-open transitions match a deterministic failure-and-recovery trace.

programs.title: Bounded HTTP load probe:
programs.scope: **Bounded HTTP load probe:** run a configured request schedule, limit concurrency, record latency buckets, and export reproducible summaries.
programs.forecast: E: tasks/async or worker threads, arithmetic and histogram support
programs.acceptance: Concurrency never exceeds the limit; cancellation leaves no active workers or missing results.

programs.title: Framed TCP task broker:
programs.scope: **Framed TCP task broker:** accept length-prefixed JSON jobs, acknowledge IDs, enforce frame limits, and maintain a persistent pending list.
programs.forecast: E: unified TCP/project profile, byte-buffer operations and binary integers
programs.acceptance: Split and coalesced writes yield the same jobs; oversized/truncated frames are rejected.

programs.title: Line-based room chat:
programs.scope: **Line-based room chat:** maintain several TCP peers, nicknames and rooms; broadcast messages, bound queues, and clean up disconnected peers.
programs.forecast: E: multiplexed sockets, buffer operations and cancellation
programs.acceptance: A slow or disconnected peer does not prevent messages reaching other room members.

programs.title: SMTP capture server:
programs.scope: **SMTP capture server:** support HELO/EHLO, MAIL, RCPT, DATA, RSET and QUIT; handle dot stuffing and save received messages locally.
programs.coverage: Protocol enums, CRLF parsing, file persistence
programs.forecast: E: TCP/string integration and recoverable per-connection errors
programs.acceptance: An independent SMTP client delivers a message; dot-stuffed lines and invalid command order are handled correctly.

programs.title: RESP key-value server:
programs.scope: **RESP key-value server:** implement a bounded PING/GET/SET/DEL/INCR command set, expirations, a snapshot, and command errors.
programs.coverage: Nested frame parsing, maps, integers, time
programs.forecast: E: unified TCP, numeric parsing, byte slicing and map deletion
programs.acceptance: An independent RESP client agrees on null replies, binary values and integer overflow errors.

programs.title: UDP service directory:
programs.scope: **UDP service directory:** announce services, reply to discovery requests, age out peers, deduplicate announcements, and print a registry.
programs.forecast: E: UDP and socket address types
programs.acceptance: Duplicate/out-of-order announcements do not corrupt the registry; stale peers expire.

programs.title: DNS lookup diagnostic:
programs.scope: **DNS lookup diagnostic:** issue A/AAAA queries, match response IDs, decode bounded compression pointers, retry, and print answers/errors.
programs.forecast: E: UDP, struct-like byte codecs, bitwise operations and timeout recovery
programs.acceptance: Local DNS fixtures cover valid compression, pointer cycles, truncation and mismatched IDs.

programs.title: Small WebSocket room server:
programs.scope: **Small WebSocket room server:** upgrade HTTP, accept bounded text frames, handle ping/pong/close, broadcast, and reject unsupported frames.
programs.forecast: E: upgraded connections, byte/bit operations, digest/base64 and multiplexing
programs.acceptance: An independent client exchanges Unicode text and ping/pong; invalid masking and over-limit frames fail predictably.

programs.title: MQTT telemetry sink:
programs.scope: **MQTT telemetry sink:** implement CONNECT, QoS-0 PUBLISH, PING and DISCONNECT; validate packet lengths and persist a per-topic history.
programs.forecast: E: TCP integration, binary codecs and recoverable peer errors
programs.acceptance: A local client publishes multiple topics; unsupported QoS and malformed lengths are rejected.

programs.title: Chunked TCP file transfer:
programs.scope: **Chunked TCP file transfer:** pair a sender and receiver with chunk acknowledgements, resume offsets, checksums and safe final-file publication.
programs.forecast: E: unified TCP, file handles, seek, hashing and I/O recovery
programs.acceptance: Interrupted transfer resumes and reproduces exact bytes; a corrupted chunk is detected.

programs.title: Unix-domain command bus:
programs.scope: **Unix-domain command bus:** serve local request IDs, dispatch a few commands, return structured errors, and clean up socket files on shutdown.
programs.coverage: Local IPC, resource lifetime, filesystem cleanup
programs.forecast: E: Unix sockets, context-managed resources and graceful shutdown
programs.acceptance: Multiple local clients receive correctly correlated replies; restart handles a stale socket path.

programs.title: Directory inventory reporter:
programs.scope: **Directory inventory reporter:** traverse a tree, apply exclusions, record sizes/types/times, aggregate by extension, and export a manifest.
programs.forecast: E: stat/scandir or walk, sorting and per-file error recovery
programs.acceptance: Fixture manifests match; symlinks, inaccessible paths and empty directories follow the documented policy.

programs.title: Batch rename planner:
programs.scope: **Batch rename planner:** apply naming rules, preview collisions, execute an approved plan in a fixture tree, and emit a reversible journal.
programs.forecast: E: rename, canonical paths, metadata and recoverable file errors
programs.acceptance: Collisions cause no partial renames; applying the reverse journal restores original names.

programs.title: Duplicate-file finder:
programs.scope: **Duplicate-file finder:** group by size then digest, verify candidate bytes, report duplicates, and export an optional deduplication plan.
programs.forecast: E: metadata, incremental digests and streaming reads
programs.acceptance: Equal-sized different files remain distinct; hash matches are confirmed by byte comparison.

programs.title: Incremental snapshot backup:
programs.scope: **Incremental snapshot backup:** copy changed files, store version manifests, restore a selected version, and enforce a simple retention policy.
programs.forecast: E: traversal, streaming copies, metadata and controlled deletion
programs.acceptance: A restored fixture tree matches its snapshot; an interrupted snapshot is never advertised as complete.

programs.title: Two-tree synchronization planner:
programs.scope: **Two-tree synchronization planner:** compare source and destination, identify conflicts, produce ordered copy/remove operations, and validate a dry run.
programs.forecast: E: metadata, traversal, hashing and richer collections
programs.acceptance: The plan is idempotent and preserves conflicts instead of silently overwriting them.

programs.title: Content-addressed artifact store:
programs.scope: **Content-addressed artifact store:** import files by digest, attach named manifests, retrieve artifacts, and collect only unreferenced blobs.
programs.forecast: E: digests, metadata, streaming copies and deletion
programs.acceptance: Shared blobs are stored once; collection preserves every blob reachable from a live manifest.

programs.title: Batch text normalizer:
programs.scope: **Batch text normalizer:** process an explicit file manifest, normalize line endings and trailing spaces, preview changes, save backups, and report results.
programs.coverage: Unicode, string slices, text I/O, atomic replacement
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Reapplying normalization changes nothing; backups reproduce original UTF-8 bytes and line endings.

programs.title: Layered configuration merger:
programs.scope: **Layered configuration merger:** merge nested base/site/user files, track value provenance, flag type conflicts, and export the resolved document.
programs.forecast: E: general mapping iteration and recursive record traversal
programs.acceptance: Override precedence and provenance are correct; incompatible value types produce precise paths.

programs.title: Download-folder organizer:
programs.scope: **Download-folder organizer:** classify by extension and date, preview target folders, resolve filename collisions, move files, and journal changes.
programs.coverage: Paths, metadata, date formatting, file mutation
programs.forecast: E: stat, rename and general date formatting
programs.acceptance: A fixture run matches its preview; name collisions do not overwrite unrelated files.

programs.title: Fixture-tree scaffolder:
programs.scope: **Fixture-tree scaffolder:** consume a JSON manifest, validate relative names, create directories and text/binary fixtures, and emit a cleanup receipt.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: The generated tree matches the manifest; absolute/traversal names and existing-file collisions are rejected.

programs.title: CSV/JSON converter:
programs.scope: **CSV/JSON converter:** handle quoted cells and embedded newlines, apply declared column types, select columns, and report invalid rows.
programs.coverage: Text codecs, type conversion, tabular data
programs.forecast: E: CSV adapter, numeric conversions and row-level error recovery
programs.acceptance: Round trips preserve commas, quotes, empty cells and embedded newlines.

programs.title: Schema-driven record cleaner:
programs.scope: **Schema-driven record cleaner:** validate fixed fields, normalize strings and UTC timestamps, apply defaults, and write accepted/rejected JSON records.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Every input record is either preserved in accepted output or reported with field-level rejection reasons.

programs.title: Streaming JSONL transformer:
programs.scope: **Streaming JSONL transformer:** read line by line, filter/project fields, maintain bounded batches, quarantine bad rows, and checkpoint offsets.
programs.forecast: E: file handles/seek, iterators and recoverable decode errors
programs.acceptance: Memory remains bounded with increasing input; restart neither loses nor repeats committed batches.

programs.title: CSV join utility:
programs.scope: **CSV join utility:** perform inner/left joins on declared keys, handle duplicate keys, select output fields, and report unmatched rows.
programs.forecast: E: CSV, tuple-key dictionaries, mapping iteration and sorting
programs.acceptance: Duplicate-key multiplicities and unmatched rows agree with a small independent reference implementation.

programs.title: Nested JSON diff and patch:
programs.scope: **Nested JSON diff and patch:** compare objects and arrays, produce path-based changes, validate old values, and apply or reject a patch.
programs.forecast: E: mapping iteration, list mutation and recursive value types
programs.acceptance: Applying a generated patch reconstructs the target; a stale base document fails without partial mutation.

programs.title: Event-log consistency checker:
programs.scope: **Event-log consistency checker:** validate event IDs, sequence progression, UTC ordering and allowed state transitions; export a diagnostic report.
programs.coverage: Enums, sets, temporal invariants, pretty output
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Fixtures identify exact duplicate IDs, missing sequence numbers and invalid transitions.

programs.title: Versioned configuration migrator:
programs.scope: **Versioned configuration migrator:** chain explicit schema migrations, validate each version, back up inputs, and recover from an incomplete upgrade.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Every supported old version reaches the same current schema; invalid inputs preserve the original file.

programs.title: Contact import deduplicator:
programs.scope: **Contact import deduplicator:** normalize names/addresses, merge by declared keys, retain provenance, and separate ambiguous conflicts for review.
programs.coverage: Unicode, dictionaries, stable ordering, business rules
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Re-import is idempotent; conflicting values remain visible instead of being silently discarded.

programs.title: JSON query console:
programs.scope: **JSON query console:** support a small filter/project/order/group grammar, validate field paths, and pretty-print results from saved datasets.
programs.forecast: E: richer collection traversal, sort keys and arithmetic
programs.acceptance: Equivalent queries produce matching results; malformed expressions report their source positions.

programs.title: JSONL partition writer:
programs.scope: **JSONL partition writer:** load a bounded input file, group records by date/topic, write named shards, and persist row-count manifests.
programs.coverage: Nested collections, strings, paths, atomic writes
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: The shards contain every input record exactly once and their counts match the manifest.

programs.title: LRU cache workbench:
programs.scope: **LRU cache workbench:** replay GET/PUT/DELETE traces, enforce capacity, inspect recency, collect hit statistics, and save/restore state.
programs.forecast: E: map deletion/reordering or deque operations, numeric division
programs.acceptance: Eviction order matches a reference trace, including overwrite and zero-capacity cases.

programs.title: TTL key-value notebook:
programs.scope: **TTL key-value notebook:** store JSON values with deadlines, inspect live entries, sweep expired entries, and persist bounded snapshots.
programs.coverage: Time, JSON, map/list updates, state recovery
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Expiration and replacement deadlines survive restart; expired entries never appear in reads.

programs.title: Persistent priority work queue:
programs.scope: **Persistent priority work queue:** enqueue with priorities, preserve tie order, cancel or retry jobs, and reconstruct the heap from a snapshot.
programs.forecast: E: heapq, richer tuple ordering and collection operations
programs.acceptance: Pop order is stable for ties and unchanged after restoring a saved queue.

programs.title: Small document search engine:
programs.scope: **Small document search engine:** tokenize text, build an inverted index, update/remove documents, evaluate AND/OR queries, and rank results.
programs.forecast: E: set algebra, map iteration/deletion and sorting
programs.acceptance: Results agree with a brute-force scan; removed documents disappear from all postings.

programs.title: Prefix autocomplete index:
programs.scope: **Prefix autocomplete index:** insert/update terms, delete terms, count usage, retrieve ranked prefix suggestions, and export the dictionary.
programs.forecast: E: typed recursive records, mutable nested maps and sorting
programs.acceptance: Suggestions match a reference scan for Unicode prefixes, updates and deletions.

programs.title: Bloom-filter ingestion gate:
programs.scope: **Bloom-filter ingestion gate:** size a filter, ingest keys, persist its bit array, report likely duplicates, and compare against an exact audit set.
programs.forecast: E: bytearray/bit operations, digest API and math
programs.acceptance: No inserted key becomes a false negative; measured false positives and storage size are reported.

programs.title: External record sorter:
programs.scope: **External record sorter:** generate bounded sorted runs, merge them, verify ordering, and clean up interrupted temporary runs.
programs.coverage: Iterators, heaps, file resources, stable sort
programs.forecast: E: streaming files, heapq, keyed sorting and resource cleanup
programs.acceptance: Output equals an in-memory reference while peak working data remains within the configured bound.

programs.title: Time-series ring-buffer recorder:
programs.scope: **Time-series ring-buffer recorder:** ingest samples, retain a rolling window, query summaries, export selected intervals, and restore saved state.
programs.forecast: E: deque operations, division and numerical helpers
programs.acceptance: Retention boundaries and summaries match a reference list across wraparound and restart.

programs.title: Interval-indexed log browser:
programs.scope: **Interval-indexed log browser:** import start/end spans, index overlaps, query a time range, update records, and show matching events.
programs.forecast: E: typed records, ordered insertion and collection mutation
programs.acceptance: Indexed results equal brute-force interval checks for touching, nested and empty intervals.

programs.title: Append-only miniature database:
programs.scope: **Append-only miniature database:** implement GET/SET/DELETE, journal records, replay on startup, detect an incomplete tail, and compact to a snapshot.
programs.forecast: E: append/seek/fsync, checksums, truncation and error recovery
programs.acceptance: Restart after each injected write interruption yields the last complete committed state.

programs.title: Route planner:
programs.scope: **Route planner:** load a named weighted graph, apply closures, use Bellman–Ford, reconstruct routes, and explain unreachable paths or negative cycles.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Small graphs agree with an exhaustive oracle; closures and negative cycles produce correct diagnostics.

programs.title: Dependency build planner:
programs.scope: **Dependency build planner:** load targets and edges, select requested targets, find prerequisites, produce build layers, and explain cycles.
programs.coverage: Graph traversal, sets, maps, deterministic reports
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Every prerequisite precedes its target; cycle fixtures return a valid cycle witness.

programs.title: Small shift scheduler:
programs.scope: **Small shift scheduler:** read availability and staffing requirements, use bounded backtracking, score candidates, and explain unsatisfied constraints.
programs.forecast: E: dataclasses, nested list mutation and richer ordering
programs.acceptance: Every proposed schedule satisfies hard constraints; tiny cases match exhaustive best scores.

programs.title: Parcel packing planner:
programs.scope: **Parcel packing planner:** group items under capacity rules, use a documented packing heuristic, retain package manifests, and report unplaceable items.
programs.forecast: E: keyed sorting and typed records
programs.acceptance: Every item is assigned once or rejected explicitly; no package exceeds its capacity.

programs.title: Terrain route visualizer:
programs.scope: **Terrain route visualizer:** load a text grid, assign terrain costs, find a path with A*, render it in ASCII, and export search statistics.
programs.forecast: E: heapq, nested sequence updates and numeric helpers
programs.acceptance: Path cost agrees with a reference shortest-path solver; unreachable destinations are handled.

programs.title: Dependency impact auditor:
programs.scope: **Dependency impact auditor:** load a module graph, compute reverse dependencies and strongly connected groups, then explain the impact of changed modules.
programs.forecast: E: richer sets/maps and convenient recursive records
programs.acceptance: Reported affected modules match reachability; strongly connected groups satisfy mutual reachability.

programs.title: Repeated-phrase document auditor:
programs.scope: **Repeated-phrase document auditor:** tokenize documents, index n-grams, merge overlapping matches, and produce a cross-document report.
programs.forecast: E: list slicing, tuple-key maps and sorting
programs.acceptance: Known repeated passages are found with stable positions and without counting overlapping windows repeatedly.

programs.title: Huffman file compressor:
programs.scope: **Huffman file compressor:** construct a codebook, encode a bounded file, write a checked container, decode it, and report compression statistics.
programs.forecast: E: heapq, binary codecs, mutable bytes and division
programs.acceptance: Empty, single-symbol and binary fixtures round-trip; malformed codebooks are rejected.

programs.title: Timetable journey planner:
programs.scope: **Timetable journey planner:** load scheduled connections, account for transfer time, compute earliest arrival, and print the selected journey.
programs.forecast: E: heapq, duration operations and typed records
programs.acceptance: Results match exhaustive tiny timetables, including overnight journeys and missed transfers.

programs.title: Sudoku batch-solving tool:
programs.scope: **Sudoku batch-solving tool:** read boards, validate givens, solve with a search budget, detect multiple solutions, and export diagnostics and statistics.
programs.forecast: E: nested list mutation, integer division/modulo and richer record types
programs.acceptance: Invalid, unsatisfiable, unique and multiple-solution boards are distinguished correctly.

programs.title: Access-log analyzer:
programs.scope: **Access-log analyzer:** parse a documented log format, extract request fields, aggregate status/path counts, select time windows, and report malformed lines.
programs.forecast: E: regex match groups, numeric parsing and sorting
programs.acceptance: Parsed fields and aggregate counts match hand-labeled fixture logs.

programs.title: Small static-site builder:
programs.scope: **Small static-site builder:** process a defined Markdown subset, generate heading anchors/navigation, escape HTML, and write a linked site from a manifest.
programs.coverage: Unicode parsing, recursion, files, HTML generation
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Golden pages match; duplicate headings remain linkable and source HTML is safely escaped.

programs.title: Template rendering engine:
programs.scope: **Template rendering engine:** support escaped substitutions, a bounded loop/condition syntax and includes; detect missing values and include cycles.
programs.coverage: Recursive parsing, scopes, JSON, source errors
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Nested templates match golden output; include cycles and malformed blocks report useful locations.

programs.title: Expression calculator with variables:
programs.scope: **Expression calculator with variables:** parse numbers and operators, support parentheses and assignment, retain a session, and report expression errors.
programs.forecast: E: numeric conversion, division/modulo and recoverable arithmetic errors
programs.acceptance: Precedence matches an independent evaluator; division by zero does not destroy the session.

programs.title: INI-style configuration editor:
programs.scope: **INI-style configuration editor:** parse sections and quoted string values, preserve a documented comment policy, expand named variables, and rewrite files.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Parse/write/parse preserves values; duplicate keys and variable cycles are diagnosed.

programs.title: Minimal command shell:
programs.scope: **Minimal command shell:** parse quoting, run external commands and bounded pipelines, manage environment overrides, and report exit statuses.
programs.forecast: E: subprocess, pipes, process groups and signal handling
programs.acceptance: Arguments retain their quoting semantics; a failed pipeline leaves no live child processes.

programs.title: Python source-outline browser:
programs.scope: **Python source-outline browser:** read a project manifest, parse modules, list definitions/imports/docstrings, and emit a cross-linked HTML outline.
programs.coverage: AST traversal, recursive nodes, project structure
programs.forecast: E: AST adapter or typed parser nodes
programs.acceptance: Outlines agree with CPython AST fixtures, including decorators and nested definitions.

programs.title: Regex batch rewrite tool:
programs.scope: **Regex batch rewrite tool:** prevalidate ASCII rules, preview literal replacements, back up explicitly listed files, and produce a per-rule audit.
programs.coverage: Regex, text I/O, logging, dry-run behavior
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Invalid rules cause no writes; literal replacement semantics match in Python and Rust.

programs.title: Tiny automation-language interpreter:
programs.scope: **Tiny automation-language interpreter:** implement a documented let/if/repeat grammar, build an AST, execute within a step budget, and trace variables.
programs.coverage: Tagged AST nodes, scopes, recursion, diagnostics
programs.forecast: E: dataclasses/tagged unions, numeric conversion and recoverable errors
programs.acceptance: The step limit terminates loops; nested scopes and source-position errors match fixtures.

programs.title: Stateful syntax-highlighting exporter:
programs.scope: **Stateful syntax-highlighting exporter:** lex a small configuration language, handle multiline strings/comments, escape input, and emit themed HTML.
programs.coverage: Enums, state machines, Unicode slices, HTML
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Token boundaries match fixtures; unfinished strings and hostile markup cannot corrupt output HTML.

programs.title: Recurring reminder daemon:
programs.scope: **Recurring reminder daemon:** load fixed-interval UTC reminders, advance deadlines, apply a missed-run policy, persist progress, and log due reminders.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: A supplied clock trace yields the expected reminders before and after restart.

programs.title: Cron schedule explorer:
programs.scope: **Cron schedule explorer:** parse a documented five-field subset, calculate the next runs, explain rejected expressions, and export a schedule.
programs.forecast: E: datetime field access, weekday/calendar operations and numeric parsing
programs.acceptance: Month boundaries, leap days and weekday combinations match known UTC fixtures.

programs.title: Activity timer journal:
programs.scope: **Activity timer journal:** start/pause/resume/stop named sessions over HTTP, retain completed intervals, and export totals in seconds.
programs.forecast: B
programs.acceptance: Paused time is excluded; illegal transitions fail; completed intervals survive restart.

programs.title: Rotating log router:
programs.scope: **Rotating log router:** read several live logs, parse levels, apply filters, route to files, rotate by size, and preserve read positions.
programs.forecast: E: seek/tail, metadata, configurable handlers and I/O recovery
programs.acceptance: Rotation and restart neither skip nor duplicate complete input lines.

programs.title: Job deadline inspector:
programs.scope: **Job deadline inspector:** read expected jobs and completion events, classify late/missing/on-time results, apply grace periods, and emit a report.
programs.forecast: B
